title: Adult with low mood and fatigue
opening: I have just been feeling really tired and down lately. I do not know what is wrong with me.

disclosures.response: It has been going on for about two months now. It just keeps getting harder to get through the day.
I feel sad most of the time. Nothing seems to make me happy anymore. Sometimes I wonder if things will ever get better.
I have trouble falling asleep and then I wake up at four in the morning and cannot get back to sleep. I am exhausted all day.
I have lost my appetite. My clothes are looser, maybe ten pounds in the last month.
I used to love gardening and seeing my friends, but I just do not have the energy or interest for any of it anymore.
I have been having a glass of wine most evenings, maybe two. It helps me relax. I do not use any other substances.
I live alone. My daughter calls sometimes, but I do not want to burden her with this.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes permission or rapport.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission before exploring sensitive topics.

metrics.name: Mood assessment
metrics.rationale: Explores the quality, duration, and severity of the mood disturbance.
metrics.coaching_hint: Explore the mood: 'How long have you felt this way, and how low does it get?'

metrics.name: Somatic symptoms
metrics.rationale: Screens for sleep disturbance, fatigue, and appetite or weight changes.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about somatic symptoms: 'How are your sleep, energy, and appetite?'

metrics.name: Risk and safety assessment
metrics.rationale: Assesses suicidal ideation, intent, plan, and access to means.
metrics.coaching_hint: Assess safety directly: 'Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?'

metrics.name: Functional impact and support
metrics.rationale: Evaluates impact on daily functioning, interests, and social support.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about function and support: 'How is this affecting your daily life, and who supports you?'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Checks understanding and confirms the immediate next step or referral.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm next steps and check understanding, including follow-up or resources.
